tools.name: list-personas
tools.description: Returns all brand personas of the account. A persona is a brand voice: tone, audience, writing style and visual identity used for generated posts.

tools.name: get-persona
tools.description: Returns one persona with all brand voice fields (tone, audience, colors, fonts, logos, design examples) and connectionIds, the accounts it may post to.

tools.name: create-persona
tools.description: Creates a brand persona. Only name and type (PERSONAL or COMPANY) are required. Returns the new persona. Files (font, logos, design examples) are uploaded with presign-upload first and passed as asset objects.

tools.name: update-persona
tools.description: Changes the given fields of a persona and leaves all other fields as they are. Returns the updated persona.

tools.name: delete-persona
tools.description: Deletes a persona and everything tied to it: its calendar items, all their posts including published ones, and its connections unless another persona uses them. Publishing through those connections stops. Irreversible. Two steps: the first call deletes nothing and returns needsConfirmation, a summar

tools.name: list-connections
tools.description: Returns the connected social accounts (publishing destinations) of the account, such as one LinkedIn page or one Instagram business account. status is CONNECTED, EXPIRED, ERROR or PLACEHOLDER. Can be filtered by personaId.

tools.name: get-connection
tools.description: Returns one connection: platform, name, status, approval setting (needsApproval) and when its login expires (validTill). Never returns tokens.

tools.name: start-connection
tools.description: Starts connecting a LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram or X account. Returns an authorization URL that must be opened in a web browser to finish; this tool cannot finish the connection itself. The new connection then appears in list-connections.

tools.name: refresh-connection
tools.description: Renews the login of an EXPIRED or expiring connection. Returns the new status. LinkedIn and X renew; Facebook and Instagram renew only before they expire, otherwise they need start-connection again.

tools.name: delete-connection
tools.description: Removes one publishing destination and its authorization. Publishing to it stops until it is connected again. Two steps: the first call deletes nothing and returns needsConfirmation, a summary, and a confirmToken valid for 5 minutes; a second call with that confirmToken deletes.

tools.name: list-content-events
tools.description: Returns calendar items (content events). A calendar item is one planned post topic in one persona's voice for one or more connections at a date. Can be filtered by status, date range and campaign. Paginated with limit and skip.

tools.name: get-content-event
tools.description: Returns one calendar item: topic, goal, persona, selected connections, date, format (contentFormat "image" or "carousel", with carouselSlides) and status.

tools.name: create-content-event
tools.description: Creates a calendar item (topic, persona, destinations, date, format). Does not generate posts; generation is a separate step (trigger-generation). Destinations are given as platforms (network names, resolved to the persona's connected accounts) or selectedConnections (connection IDs); with neither,

tools.name: update-content-event
tools.description: Changes the given fields of a calendar item. Changing the date moves its unpublished posts with it. Changing contentFormat or carouselSlides applies to posts generated afterwards; existing posts stay as they are. Returns the updated item.

tools.name: finalize-content-event
tools.description: Processes the ready posts of a calendar item: posts on connections without approval (needsApproval false) are scheduled and publish publicly at their time; posts on connections with approval stay READY_TO_APPROVE.

tools.name: delete-content-event
tools.description: Deletes a calendar item and its posts, except posts already PUBLISHED or PUBLISHING, which stay. Returns 409 while generation is running. Irreversible. Two steps: the first call deletes nothing and returns needsConfirmation, a summary, and a confirmToken valid for 5 minutes; a second call with that

tools.name: list-posts
tools.description: Returns posts. A post is one finished piece of content (copy plus a single image or a carousel) for one connection; one calendar item makes one post per connection. Can be filtered by status, platform and calendar item (initiatorId). Paginated with limit and skip.

tools.name: get-post
tools.description: Returns one post: copy, headline, image URL, format (contentFormat), platform, connection, schedule, status and publish time. A carousel post also returns its slides in order.

tools.name: approve-post
tools.description: Approves a post for publishing on its social network. A post whose scheduled time has passed publishes immediately; otherwise it becomes SCHEDULED and publishes at that time. Costs no credits.

tools.name: regenerate-post-text
tools.description: Writes new copy for a post with the AI pipeline, replacing the current copy. Costs 6 credits. Status is REGENERATING until it returns to READY_TO_APPROVE. Only for posts that belong to a calendar item. Returns an error for a carousel post.

tools.name: delete-post
tools.description: Deletes one post. The status of its calendar item is recalculated. Irreversible (reject-post keeps the post instead). Two steps: the first call deletes nothing and returns needsConfirmation, a summary, and a confirmToken valid for 5 minutes; a second call with that confirmToken deletes.

tools.name: reject-post
tools.description: Marks a post REJECTED. It is never published and stays visible for reference. Only for posts not yet PUBLISHED. Costs no credits.

tools.name: edit-post-copy
tools.description: Replaces the stored copy (and optionally the title) of a post with the given text. No AI, no credits. Does not change the destination. A post that is already published keeps the copy that went live.

tools.name: regenerate-post-image
tools.description: Creates a new image for a post with the AI pipeline, replacing the current image. Costs 12 credits. Status is REGENERATING until it returns to READY_TO_APPROVE. Only for posts that belong to a calendar item. Returns an error for a carousel post; a carousel is made again as a whole with trigger-gener

tools.name: trigger-generation
tools.description: Generates posts for one calendar item, one per destination: research, copy, headline and image in the persona's voice. An item whose contentFormat is "carousel" gets a carousel of carouselSlides slides instead of the single image, which takes longer to make. Running it again deletes the item's exist

tools.name: generate-for-content-events
tools.description: Starts generation for several calendar items at once and returns a per-item summary (post IDs and status, or an error). Items that are already generating restart. Same results and costs as trigger-generation for each item.

tools.name: get-generation-status
tools.description: Returns the status of posts, by post IDs or by calendar item. Posts move through GENERATION_IN_PROGRESS, EXTRACTING, GENERATING and COPY_GENERATED and end as SCHEDULED, READY_TO_APPROVE or GENERATION_FAILED. allComplete is true when every post has ended.

tools.name: get-me
tools.description: Returns the signed-in user: name, email, role and time zone. Campaign and post times follow this time zone.

tools.name: set-my-timezone
tools.description: Sets the signed-in user's IANA time zone. Campaigns planned afterwards use it; existing campaigns keep theirs.

tools.name: list-users
tools.description: Returns the team members of the account: id, name, email, role (OWNER, ADMIN or MEMBER) and status. Inviting, removing and role changes are not available through this server.

tools.name: get-user
tools.description: Returns one team member: name, email, role, status and time zone.

tools.name: get-account
tools.description: Returns the account: credit balance, business name and location.

tools.name: get-prices
tools.description: Returns the available credit packages and their prices. Purchases are not available through this server.

tools.name: list-transactions
tools.description: Returns recent credit transactions of the account (purchases and spends).

tools.name: get-analytics
tools.description: Returns totals of reach, engagement and impressions for the account over a time window (1 to 365 days, default 30).

tools.name: get-analytics-filters
tools.description: Returns the available analytics filters: platforms, pages and date ranges.

tools.name: get-analytics-posts
tools.description: Returns engagement, impressions and reach per published post. Can be filtered by platform and page. Paginated with a cursor.

tools.name: refresh-analytics
tools.description: Fetches fresh analytics from the account's connected social accounts and returns the updated stats.

tools.name: list-campaigns
tools.description: Returns campaigns of the account, newest first. Can be filtered by status (DRAFT, PLAN_READY, LAUNCHED, FAILED). Paginated with limit and skip.

tools.name: get-campaign
tools.description: Returns one campaign. plan.pitch is the plan in plain words: targets (who it reaches), reach (per target: network, account, posts, time of day), talk (how it speaks to them), posters (who posts and their role) and frequency (posts per network). plan.blueprint.contentEvents is the calendar; each item

tools.name: list-campaign-goals
tools.description: Returns the campaign goal strings accepted by plan-campaign.

tools.name: plan-campaign
tools.description: Starts planning a campaign for the given personas and goal: researches the audience and how to reach it on the public web, then writes the calendar and post copy. Nothing is generated or published. Returns campaignId immediately; planning takes a few minutes (get-campaign-planning shows progress). W

tools.name: retry-plan
tools.description: Plans a FAILED campaign again with its original inputs. Returns 409 when the campaign already has a plan or is planning.

tools.name: adjust-campaign
tools.description: Requests a change to a PLAN_READY campaign from a plain-language message (who it reaches, how, the message, who posts, how often, dates, or single calendar items and their format); everything the change does not touch stays. Returns action: "ask" (a clarifying question), "decline" (the reason), "con

tools.name: undo-campaign-adjust
tools.description: Reverts the most recent adjust-campaign change; each call goes one change further back. Not available after launch.

tools.name: launch-plan
tools.description: Generates and schedules every post of a PLAN_READY campaign; status becomes LAUNCHED. Costs 30 credits per post, one post per connection on each calendar item. Posts on connections without approval publish publicly at their time; others wait as READY_TO_APPROVE. Returns generated and generateFailed

tools.name: get-campaign-planning
tools.description: Returns planning progress of a campaign: campaignStatus (DRAFT while planning, ADJUSTING, PLAN_READY or FAILED), steps, and the plan once ready, in the same shape as get-campaign. Planning usually takes a few minutes.

tools.name: delete-campaign
tools.description: Deletes a campaign, the calendar items it created and their posts. Irreversible. Two steps: the first call deletes nothing and returns needsConfirmation, a summary, and a confirmToken valid for 5 minutes; a second call with that confirmToken deletes.

tools.name: search-scenes
tools.description: Searches the stock scene library by keywords. Returns matching scenes with IDs, thumbnails and metadata. Paginated.

tools.name: get-scene
tools.description: Returns one scene with its metadata and image URL.

tools.name: presign-upload
tools.description: Returns a time-limited upload URL and the final object key for one file (for a post image or persona asset). The file is uploaded with an HTTP PUT to that URL.

tools.name: signed-get
tools.description: Returns a time-limited URL to read one private file by its object key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list-personas, get-persona, start-connection, list-content-events, list-posts, get-post, trigger-generation, get-generation-status, get-me, list-users, get-user, get-analytics-posts, get-campaign, plan-campaign, get-scene, signed-get · Private data: create-persona, get-connection, presign-upload, signed-get · Public sink: get-persona, create-persona, list-content-events, create-content-event, finalize-content-event, list-posts, get-post, approve-post, regenerate-post-text, delete-post, reject-post, edit-post-copy, regenerate-post-image, trigger-generation, generate-for-content-events, get-generation-status, get-me, list-users, get-user, get-analytics-posts, get-campaign, plan-campaign, adjust-campaign, launch-plan, presign-upload · Destructive: delete-persona, delete-connection, get-content-event, create-content-event, delete-content-event, get-post, delete-post, get-campaign, adjust-campaign, delete-campaign.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list-personas, get-persona, start-connection, list-content-events, list-posts, get-post, trigger-generation, get-generation-status, get-me, list-users, get-user, get-analytics-posts, get-campaign, plan-campaign, get-scene, signed-get · Private data: create-persona, get-connection, presign-upload, signed-get · Public sink: get-persona, create-persona, list-content-events, create-content-event, finalize-content-event, list-posts, get-post, approve-post, regenerate-post-text, delete-post, reject-post, edit-post-copy, regenerate-post-image, trigger-generation, generate-for-content-events, get-generation-status, get-me, list-users, get-user, get-analytics-posts, get-campaign, plan-campaign, adjust-campaign, launch-plan, presign-upload · Destructive: delete-persona, delete-connection, get-content-event, create-content-event, delete-content-event, get-post, delete-post, get-campaign, adjust-campaign, delete-campaign

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
